hero.label: Made for PingCAP
hero.headline: I am eager to drive growth at PingCAP.
hero.subheadline: I am excited to join PingCAP as an SDR and contribute to TiDB's innovative solutions. The opportunity to engage with prospects and provide valuable database solutions aligns perfectly with my skills and aspirations.

whyCompany.title: TiDB's scalability and performance
whyCompany.body: PingCAP's TiDB stands out for its impressive scalability and performance, which resonate with businesses' growing needs. I'm eager to support these innovative solutions as an SDR.

whyCompany.title: Exciting growth phase
whyCompany.body: PingCAP is in an exhilarating growth phase with a focus on expanding TiDB's reach worldwide. Joining at this stage allows me to drive impactful sales initiatives and contribute to its global success.

whyCompany.title: Proven BDR experience
whyCompany.body: During my time at Copygen.ai, I honed my skills in lead acquisition using HubSpot and LinkedIn, acquiring pivotal clients. This directly aligns with the prospecting and relationship-building focus of this SDR role at PingCAP.

quote: I'm thrilled by the prospect of being a key player in scaling TiDB's reach and providing top-notch database solutions.
